subject: Request: hosted API rate card + competitor matchup for AcmeAI evaluation
messages:
From: Claire Martin <claire@acmeai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation request — hosted API pricing + competitor matchup

Hi Logan,

Thanks for taking the time on the call earlier this week. We're moving AcmeAI's evaluation of hosted APIs into a formal procurement window and need an itemized rate card and a short competitor matchup that compares Redwood's hosted API pricing and packaging against OpenAI, Anthropic, Together, and AWS (SageMaker endpoints). Specifically, procurement needs:

- Per-token generation price and embed price for standard models (8k & 32k contexts)
- Discount tiers at 40k, 200k, and 1M tokens/month
- Any burst/throughput pricing differences and SLA notes for hosted customers
- Security/compliance differences that affect pricing (dedicated keying, audit logging surcharges)

We received an initial offer from OpenAI for a baseline of $0.0006/token (generation) at 200k/mo with a 12% committed discount for 12-month term; Anthropic came in a bit higher but with a PS credit. Together and AWS have different models for throughput-based capacity. Can you send a consolidated sheet and indicate whether Redwood can provide a rate-match or near-match at 200k and 1M?

Attached is our MUP (minimal usage profile) for baseline volumes. We're targeting a procurement decision by 2027-04-22.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Martin
Head of Platform Engineering | AcmeAI
Attachments: acme_mup_requirements.docx (docx)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Claire Martin <claire@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation request — hosted API pricing + competitor matchup

Hi Claire,

Appreciate the clear ask and the MUP — we can get that over to you. I'll pull together a concise rate card + competitor comparison and include our recommended discounts for the 200k and 1M tiers.

Quick note: to set proper expectations, Redwood's hosted SKU emphasizes predictable SLOs and integrated KV/prefix caching which often changes unit economics vs the raw per-token offers (we can show the effective cost after batching & cache). Would you like us to include a modeled cost-per-effective-token that factors in caching benefits?

We’ll aim to send a first draft by EOD 2027-04-16. If procurement wants a call to review the spreadsheet, I'm available 2027-04-19 afternoon PST.

Best,
Logan Wright
Head of Sales — Hosted Platforms
Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Evaluation request — hosted API pricing + competitor matchup

Team — forwarding Acme's MUP and request. Ask: can you assemble a one-page competitor comparison + a rate card for hosted API that includes: baseline per-token list price (8k/32k), embed price, recommended committed discounts at these bands: 40k, 200k, 1M, and any SLA/throughput callouts that affect price. Also include a short note on what value-adds we can point to that justify price differentials (batching/caching/managed KV).

Data points I want in the sheet:
- OpenAI public list numbers + our suggested match/offer for 200k and 1M (client explicitly asked about match)
- Anthropic baseline + any promotional credits we've seen in similar deals
- Together's pricing notes (they're more throughput/customer-hosted focused)
- AWS SageMaker: note enterprise discounts and instance-hour equivalents rather than pure per-token lines

Rishi — can you include a quick model showing effective cost after reasonable batching and a conservative caching uplift? Marissa — please flag any policy/compliance surcharges for VPC/private keying we should call out. Lauren — can you draft the recommended discount ladder and a short justification for each tier (we want to avoid over-discounting the initial 200k anchor).

Deadline: draft into the attached spreadsheet and return to me by EOD tomorrow (2027-04-16). I'll QA and send to the customer.

Thanks,
Logan
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 17:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Evaluation request — hosted API pricing + competitor matchup

Logan — draft attached: acme_competitor_match_draft.xlsx (see tab summary). Highlights:

- List prices (our hosted list, OpenAI public, Anthropic public, Together estimate, AWS estimate) included for 8k and 32k contexts and embeddings.
- Suggested Redwood committed tiers (monthly): 40k -> 7% off list; 200k -> 14% off list + one-time onboarding credit; 1M -> 25% off list + SLA bump (4x RTT monitoring, 99.9% uptime SLA).
- Effective cost model (Rishi): factoring conservative 20% cache uplift and batching assumptions reduces our effective per-token cost by ~18% at 200k and ~27% at 1M. Column E contains the formula; see 'effective_cost' rows.
- OpenAI note: their 12% committed discount for 200k (as Claire reported) is within reach if we include a small onboarding/commitment credit and tighten the SLA cadence.
- Anthropic: their quoted numbers are 10–18% higher than OpenAI for 32k, but they bundle some eval credits; Together and AWS require a capacity/instance conversation — price comparables are shown as effective hourly equivalents.

Two asks before I hand this to Luke for legal/pricing sign-off:
1) Logan — confirm whether you want to offer a near-match at 200k (i.e., 12% effective discount) or stick to the recommended 14% listed (which buys the onboarding credit).
2) Marissa — confirm if the VPC/keying surcharge should be shown as a flat fee or as a % uplift (I recommend flat one-time setup fee $12k for enterprise).

Attaching: acme_competitor_match_draft.xlsx

- Lauren
From: Claire Martin <claire@acmeai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Li <evan@together.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Evaluation request — hosted API pricing + competitor matchup

Logan — appreciate the fast turnaround and the spreadsheet. A couple quick items from procurement:

1) AcmeAI would prefer a line-item price match at 200k/month to the OpenAI equivalent (we saw their 12% committed discount). If Redwood can formally match that in writing (same term length), procurement will prioritize Redwood in the final scoring.
2) For the 1M tier, we care more about effective cost after caching — your effective-cost column is useful. Please include a short sentence in the offer that guarantees the caching assumptions won't invalidate SLA/runbook obligations.

If you can provide a 1-page summary (PDF) that includes a line-item 200k match and the 1M effective-cost explanation by 2027-04-22, we'll move to legal evaluation immediately.

Thanks,
Claire
Claire Martin
Head of Platform Engineering | AcmeAI
Attachments referenced: none
